summary.allocation: area-and-suitability weighted largest-remainder within each parent cell

settlementDistribution.interpretation: Refined aggregate settlement budget per L1 cell. Coarse suitability is a relative weight, not a certified local food capacity. No site, road or building is fixed yet.
assumptions: Parent = allocated children + explicit unallocated for every one of the seven budgets
Child area is the actual L1 cell area; suitability is projected from the parent distribution unless overridden
A child may only receive a population type when it also receives a settlement count of that type
limitations: Sea and lake cells carry zero population and zero settlements
Unallocated parents have no habitable L1 land in this refinement; they are not silently zeroed or moved
Exact town and city sites and roads remain unresolved
